old_problem: A final full-width link can hide intermittent phase failures, marginal lanes, temporary downtraining and prior AER. The shared code also risks importing unrelated Console or Thermal evidence unless row and Variant ID remain controlling.
disposition_reason: The row and variant unambiguously define a 10,000-redo Tx equalization test and clean link oracle. Exact LTSSM recipe, path/lane map, generation/width, phase/preset/coefficient rules, ledger and recovery are project bindings. ED duplicate-code rules preserve this variant without keeping review Pending.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2121, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, all three shared-code rows, ED-01 through ED-30 and unique Variant ID were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2122 / Wistron-HGX NV PVP HW-00001-V002 / 16b01fe25345473f was directly read from XLSX and manifest.
Source identity is Functionality row 2121 plus variant a2ad2978391bc10d; Console row 1977 and Thermal row 2287 neither share purpose nor evidence.
Bind the approved LTSSM Tx Eq Redo recipe, exact root-port/bridge/retimer/endpoint/GPU/per-lane path, target generation/width, phase and vendor-owned preset/coefficient behavior.
For each redo record request, phase/LTSSM and per-lane result, settle deadline, negotiated generation/width, enumeration, and fresh error/platform-health deltas before the next redo.
Count exactly 10,000 complete chronological redos; setup, partial events, tool restarts, retries or aggregate results without per-lane failure visibility do not count.
Stop on phase/lane anomaly, timeout, downtrain, endpoint/sibling loss, unapproved coefficient change, disqualifying AER/reset, evidence gap or safety anomaly.
Preserve first-fault artifacts, do not clear counters or automatically retry, and use only signed recovery.
No Tx equalization, LTSSM/NVQual, preset/coefficient change, PCIe query, recovery, retry or DUT operation was performed.

test_case.test_name: Per-lane first-fault-interlocked 10,000x Tx equalization redo soak
test_case.purpose: Prove exactly 10,000 Tx equalization redos on the mapped PCIe link, with each per-lane phase completing and returning to required generation/width without disqualifying errors.
required_package: Pinned approved NVIDIA LTSSM Tx Eq Redo build, command and configuration
Approved target generation/width, equalization phases, preset/coefficient ownership, transient/deadline/lane/error rules
10,000-entry durable per-redo/per-lane ledger and first-fault interlock
Dedicated idle SUT, out-of-band console, stable power/cooling and recovery
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED until Project Configuration is signed. Preserve link/equalization/error/health baselines; after point approval execute only the pinned Tx Eq Redo primitive for entries 1..10000. Durably record request, equalization phase/LTSSM, per-lane status, settled generation/width, deadline, enumeration and errors before enabling the next redo. Stop on first anomaly or gap; do not alter coefficients or retry.
test_case.expected_result: All 10,000 entries prove approved equalization phase completion on every required lane and settle within deadline at expected generation/width with endpoint/siblings healthy, no disqualifying new errors, and approved final link/host health.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS until recipe, path/lane map, generation/width, phase/preset/coefficient/deadline/error contract, ledger and recovery are approved. PASS requires 10,000 complete accepted redos. FAIL on phase/lane failure, timeout/downtrain, device loss, unapproved setting change, disqualifying error/reset or failed recovery. Missing input/artifact is BLOCKED; retries do not count.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until exact recipe/path/lane and equalization acceptance, ledger/interlock and recovery are signed.
Never import same-code Console/Thermal evidence or change presets/coefficients outside the vendor recipe.
Use an isolated idle SUT with console and explicit 10,000-redo authorization.
Commit every per-lane result and stop without retry on first anomaly.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, shared-code separation, approval and tool/configuration
Complete path/per-lane topology and initial negotiated/equalization state
Gap-detecting ledger 1..10000 with per-lane phase/LTSSM, timing, negotiated state and disposition
Correlated lspci/AER/kernel/GPU/BMC/thermal/power evidence plus artifact-integrity audit
First-fault/recovery or clean final link/endpoint/host state, no-retry audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: At the first failed phase/lane, timeout, downtrain, endpoint/sibling loss, unapproved setting change, disqualifying error/reset or artifact gap, inhibit all later redos and preserve the event. Do not replay; follow signed recovery and quarantine if expected link/topology/health is not restored.
